title: Best habit tracker
body: I tried so many productivity apps and this one is the best. Firstly product design is very cute. Then you can create custom habits, choose how often or long you want track habit. Gym 3 times per week or gym 1 hour per day - you can set up whatever u want. App has amazing reporting where you can see your performance by specific habit or all habits, week or month and use filters. Notifications are not intrusive. Big thanks to app developers.
author: AnnaWelt

title: Practical, logical and clean app
body: The essence of what is needed to build positive habits and quit bad ones
author: Martino Cooper

title: A fun & easy app to use to stay organized yet stress free
body: I've been using the Habit Track app for a few weeks now and I have to say, I'm really impressed with how simple and effective it is. The app allows me to set daily goals for myself and track my progress over time, which has been a great motivator for me to stay on track. Overall, I highly recommend the Habit Track app to anyone who wants to develop new habits or break old ones. It's easy to use, customizable, and has all the features you need to stay motivated and on track. The support section needs improvement to cater the needs
author: UmairAijaz

title: Simple & Great
body:
I have been looking for an app like this for a long time. 
What was my criteria?
-simple
-habit and streak functions
-change between goal units
-being able to set morning/day/evening habits
-lifetime deal/low price 
-good support (I asked them, they replied within 12h)
Go for it, you won't regret!
author: Imfero
